title: Five more select pickers
blurb: A customisable <select> drawn five more ways by a canvas inside its picker: 150 options under a magnifier, options on springs, a seat plan, a colour field that adds the colour you press as a new option, and a chosen option that flies into the button.
question: How far can a canvas inside a customisable select go: can it draw an option twice, move options with physics, read its own pixels back to make a new option, and keep an option on screen after the picker has closed?
result: All four work in a 2D canvas. An option drawn twice is hit tested where it was drawn last. The pixels of the chosen option outlive the picker only as a copy of the canvas, because options stop painting when the select closes.
